# apple_webhooks (Data Source)

Lists an app's webhooks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_webhooks" "app" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Read-Only

- `webhooks` (Attributes List) The webhooks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks))

<a id="nestedatt--webhooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhooks`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether events are sent.
- `event_types` (Set of String) Events sent.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the webhook.
- `name` (String) Name of the webhook.
- `url` (String) URL events are sent to.
